verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a search engine, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk or batch import, update, or delete capability. The only nearby material is a general statement that users push existing data (e.g. from CSV/JSON files) into Typesense, plus pricing copy about unlimited operations. Neither establishes a bulk-operations feature across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
